readout_other: three-channel EEG (bilateral M1, contralateral auditory cortex); ERP P1-N1 amplitude, time-frequency power, ITPC
direction_notes: LCN stimulation evoked larger, earlier ERPs and gamma power in contralateral than ipsilateral M1; auditory cortex was activated by both LCN and AUD stimulation, which the authors attribute partly to a cochlear route.

timing.protocol_description: 50% duty cycle, 1 kHz PRF, 0.5 ms pulse duration, 300 ms pulse train duration (PTD), 3 s pulse train repetition interval (PTRI); each animal had baseline, sham, LCN and AUD sessions in randomised order.

source_quotes.n_subjects: The study was conducted on eight healthy male Sprague Dawley rats (250–280 g, 8–10 weeks old).
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: Each animal underwent four recording sessions: baseline, sham, LCN stimulation, and auditory cortex (AUD) stimulation.
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: A 0.35 MHz single-element concave-shaped focused ultrasound transducer (GPS350-D25\_FL25, The Ultran Group, USA) with an aperture size of 25 mm, a focal length of 23.5 mm, and lateral and axial fullwidth at half-maximum (FWHM) dimensions of 5 mm and 29 mm, respectively, was employed in our experiments.

flags.reason: Eight rats enrolled; one animal excluded from the AUD condition, so six rats analysed for LCN/SHAM and five for AUD.
Four recording sessions include baseline and sham; two were active sonication sessions.
Isppa 2.54 W/cm2 is given without a stated domain; the text says intensity was measured in degassed water but does not tie this value to that measurement.
No masking or deafening; the AUD target and the uncoupled-transducer sham were used to probe auditory contribution, which the authors state cannot be quantified without cochlear blockade.
Quoted exposure parameters cited from ITRUSST guide ref 56 and prior stroke studies.
